title: Small bias scale bound
statement: Let $k,n,N,D$ be nonnegative integers satisfying $1\le k\le n$, $0<N$, and $2N\le D$. Let $s=\lceil nD/N\rceil$ be the scale computed from $n,N,D$. Then $s\le 4(s+1)^2$.
